name: Audit Events
description: Who created, modified, moved, deleted or published which page or asset, and when: the AEM audit log (cq:AuditEvent) for everything under a path, newest first. Page, asset (DAM) and replication events. Audit logs are purged on a schedule (on AEM as a Cloud Service possibly after only 7 days), so older activity may be gone. No Batch: deleted items' events can't be found by discovery.

inputs.label: Paths — pages, asset folders or single assets, one per line (each produces its own file)
Scope
options: This path and everything under it
Only this path itself (a single page or asset)
inputs.default: This path and everything under it
inputs.help: "Only this path itself" gives one page's or asset's own history (fastest: an exact-path query). "Only what's under this path" leaves out the entered page or folder's own events.

inputs.label: Asset events (created, metadata updated, moved, removed...)
Publish events (activate / deactivate, pages and assets)
Event types to keep (exact names; empty = all)
inputs.help: Changes and publishing by default. Other types: pages VersionCreated, PageValid, PageInvalid; assets ASSET_VIEWED, DOWNLOADED, RENDITION_UPDATED, RENDITION_DOWNLOADED, VERSIONED, ASSET_SHARED, ASSET_EXPIRED, ASSET_EXPIRING, SUBASSET_UPDATED, ACCEPTED, REJECTED, ADDED_COMMENT; replication Test, Reverse, Internal Poll. Clear the list to see every type recorded.

inputs.label: Only events from the last N days (0 = all kept)
inputs.help: Keeps the query and the file small on a large audit log.

inputs.label: Only these users (exact user IDs; empty = everyone)
Only items exactly N levels below the path (0 = any level)
